title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E5 — Brioche, Tarts and Pie
Chef Margarita Lorenzana-Manzke visits Martha's Maple Avenue kitchen and shares recipes of her famous staples from her restaurant, Republique, like banana caramel cream pie and brioche loaves.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E6 — Tomato Show
Martha shares her favorite tomato recipes from a tomato tart to Martha's favorite BLT to a simple marinara sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E7 — French Bistro Night
Martha gets a first-hand look behind the delicious French dishes at Cenadou Bistro including mussels in a tomato sauce with house-made croutons and a flatbread topped with olives and anchovies.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E7 — Know Your Vegetables
Steamed artichokes with tarragon butter; braised leeks; fried okra; whole-roasted garlic.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E8 — Grains
Mushroom barley soup; couscous royale; grits with broiled tomatoes, cheddar cheese and bacon.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E9 — Sauces
Béarnaise sauce; Kansas City barbecue sauce; tartar sauce with capers, shallots and cornichons; cocktail sauce; salsa verde.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E10 — Pork
Porchetta, a highly seasoned roasted pork; glazed ham; pork and plums.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E11 — Potatoes
Scalloped potatoes; potato salad; puréed potatoes; smashed potatoes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E12 — Salads
Frisée aux lardons; Caesar salad; stacked butter lettuce with citrus and yuzu vinaigrette.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S3 E13 — Corn
Corn fritters; corn stock serves as the base for summer corn chowder; homemade creamed corn.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E1 — Classic New England
Maple custard pie; cranberry tart with a walnut crust; Boston cream pie cupcakes; buttermilk-blueberry tart.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E3 — Midwest
Polka-dotted, double-crusted sour cherry pie; St. Louis butter cake; kransekake; sweet custard pie made with navy beans.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E4 — Northwest
A biscuit-topped blackberry cobbler; fig bars; Idaho potato cake; hazelnut cookies.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E5 — Southern Classics
Hummingbird cake layered with banana, pineapple and pecans; sweet potato pie; old-fashioned hot milk cake with chocolate whipped cream frosting.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E6 — New England
Cheddar-crusted apple pie; steamed Boston brown bread made in a can; lemon-blueberry tart; hermit bars.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E7 — Gulf
Southern caramel cake; Mississippi mud tart; Lane cake; cheese straws.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S7 E10 — West
Blum's coffee crunch cake; gâteau Basque, a dessert filled with pastry cream and cherries; pineapple upside-down cakes; date bars.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E3 — Amazing Houseplants
Martha brings the outdoors inside the home and shares her love of houseplants; she shows how to take care of the most popular houseplants and how to propagate them to create new plants.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E9 — Perfect Weekend Breakfast
Martha invites Oscar de la Renta co-creative director Laura Kim to her kitchen to create her Instagrammable and aesthetically pleasing recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E10 — Jacques Pepin Cooking His Way
Culinary legend Jacques Pepin brings his authentic French flavors to Martha's kitchen, crafting a delicious, flavorful menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E1 — Martha Throws an Argentine Asado BBQ
Martha is throwing a very special BBQ called Asado; plus Martha prepares a chimichurri sauce, her daughter Alexis's chopped salad and for dessert, fruit flavored popsicles; a perfect celebration.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E5 — Shellfish
Martha takes shellfish to the next level with sustainable oysters, baked stuffed clams and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E6 — Steak Night
From a pan seared steak with bordelaise sauce to a classic sizzling steak fired up on the grill, Martha makes steak dinners cooked to perfection with the help of her Head of Culinary at the farm.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E8 — Paella on an Open Fire
Martha creates the perfect menu for a paella party that will have your guests coming back for seconds; her paella is served with gazpacho and her incredible sangria.
